DISNEYDIVE.text: A guest dove into an EPCOT boat ride. Disney banned the party.

MACHADO.text: Venezuela's Maria Corina Machado won the 2025 Nobel, then handed the medal to Trump.

VALKYRIES.text: Golden State Valkyries are leading US sports trends today.

CATURDAY.text: Caturday is trending. The Saturday cat, American edition.

SPUDFRY.text: Idaho broke a record: 1,474 pounds of fries.

PLANKNAN.text: A Canadian grandma held a plank for five hours and beat her own record.

WEDDINGBOMB.text: A Philly wedding got photobombed by Croatian fans. They ended up on tour.
